{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A refined navy wool-blend blazer with a soft drape shoulder and single-breasted closure, cut in an oversized fit for a relaxed silhouette, falling to hip length, color #2E3B57.
A matching pleated wool-blend pencil skirt, tailored with a high waist and a clean A-line shape, ending just above the knee, color #2E3B57.
A crisp ivory silk-blouse with a slightly dropped shoulder and a delicate pintuck front detail, cut straight at the hips for a fluid drape, falling to mid-thigh length, color #FFFFF0.
Simple gold-plated stud earrings and a delicate chain necklace with a small pendant.

This outfit works perfectly for an upscale daytime wedding brunch in autumn because the smart dress code allows for polished yet comfortable pieces suitable for a restaurant setting without being overly formal. The matching navy separates provide a cohesive, sophisticated look that respects the celebratory nature of a friend's wedding while maintaining elegance appropriate for daylight hours. Choosing wool blends and silk ensures warmth against the fall weather, while the ivory blouse adds a bright, festive contrast to the dark tones, making it an ideal choice that balances tradition with personal style."}
